error.ADD_FAILED: Could not add it to the diagram list
error.BACKUP_FAILED: Cannot keep the diagram before rewriting
error.DOCUMENT_GONE: The diagram is not in the list (it was moved to the trash or removed)
error.INITIAL_FIGURE_REJECTED: Stopped because it would have overwritten a diagram from the AI or an import with the editor's starting diagram
error.MCP_CONFIG_UNREADABLE: Cannot read the MCP settings file. Fix it by hand or delete it
error.NO_DATA_DIR: Cannot find the app data folder
error.TRASH_FAILED: Cannot move it to the trash
error.UNSUPPORTED_DIAGRAM: This kind of diagram cannot be opened in the editor

import.description: Paste a flowchart or erDiagram. It opens in the editor for that kind of diagram
import.title: Import Mermaid

open.dropped: Left out parts the editor cannot show

revert.askBody: You can get your current changes back with Ctrl+Z (Undo) after reverting.
revert.askTitle: Revert to the last confirmed content?
revert.hint: Go back to the last confirmed content (you can undo it with Ctrl+Z)
revert.never: Not confirmed yet (diagrams confirmed before this version and changed afterwards cannot be reverted either)

session.cannotOpen: Cannot open “{{title}}” (it will not be saved)
session.confirmStale: Not confirmed because the AI rewrote the diagram
session.initialFigureRejected: Saving was stopped because it would have overwritten the AI's diagram with the editor's starting diagram
session.initialFigureRejectedHint: Reopen the diagram. The original source that arrived is kept
session.previousSaveFailed: Could not save the previous diagram
session.reopening: The AI rewrote the diagram, so it is being reopened
session.revertFailed: Could not revert to the confirmed content
session.switchBlocked: The diagram was not switched because it could not be saved

client.commandNote: Run it in the folder of the project that uses Lorelei (registration is per folder; add --scope user to use it everywhere). After regenerating the token, register again.
client.heading: Client setup
client.jsonNote: Paste it into a client settings file that reads mcpServers, such as Claude Code's .mcp.json. .mcp.json is meant to be committed and shared with Git, so the token goes into the repository too. If you do not want that, register with the command instead. After regenerating the token, paste it again.

mcp.description: Lets MCP clients such as Claude Code call validate / render / open_in_editor. Available only while Lorelei is open.
mcp.heading: MCP server (receive diagrams from AI)
mcp.localOnly: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only (other devices cannot connect).
mcp.regenerateWarning: Clients set up with the current token will no longer connect.

shell.unopenable: This diagram cannot be opened, so it is not saved

titleBar.closeBlocked: Not closed because the diagram could not be saved
titleBar.toggleList: Show or hide the diagram list

toolbar.confirmHint: Confirm (Ctrl+S): edits are saved automatically. Confirming keeps the current content as a point you can return to, moves it to the top of the list and clears the ●
